hypothesis: target-free uncertainty derived only from the frozen AY0 training descriptors, group ensemble and bounded prediction can route unsafe fresh-tail cases to the global fallback while preserving a non-trivial fraction of the predictor's mean gain

failed_confirmation.use: development failure diagnostic only; forbidden as later confirmation

routing.score_and_threshold_selection: inside each outer training partition only
routing.eligible_rule: use ridge when uncertainty score is at or below the selected threshold, otherwise use global
routing.selection_objective: minimum training mean neutral RMSE among policies with training P95 no worse than global; ties prefer higher ridge coverage, then score name

evaluation.harm_label: ridge neutral RMSE greater than global neutral RMSE

branch_rules.all_gates_pass: freeze the selected score and threshold on this development population, acquire another untouched official FiveK selection and confirm without changes
branch_rules.oracle_fails: close target-free routing because the fixed two-expert bank lacks sufficient value
branch_rules.score_or_crossfit_fails: close this uncertainty family and move to a different explicit operator or hard case-retrieval hypothesis
branch_rules.pass_without_new_data: retain development evidence only; no product routing

claim_ceiling: development-only target-free uncertainty and global-fallback identifiability for one bounded explicit digital-retouch predictor; not confirmation, film, stock, calibration, preference or product promotion
